WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, avg_modelconf
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_modelconf > (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase)
), reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_mean
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.brokrepstat AS status,
  q.avg_modelconf AS average_model_confidence,
  q.avg_modelconf - (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS above_average_by,
  q.avg_modelconf / r.qualifying_mean AS average_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN reference r
WHERE (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) IS NOT NULL
  AND r.qualifying_mean IS NOT NULL;
